findings.effect: The truncation flag is dropped whenever the turn already has an assistant part, including prose or a tool call. A turn cut off by the length cap therefore shows no visible length message, and a complete tool call with a length finish is saved as an interrupted tool error.

A model failure before any output saves an assistant message with no parts and no metadata.error because an error event never adds a part. This triggers paid title generation for failed turns, shows an empty reply without an error on reload, and removes the evaluation driver's error fallback.
